reuse.why: Ignores the existing shouldSkipBulkBudget selection helper used by copyPreviousMonth and setZero and instead copies the averages' inline SQL filter, income check and sign flip.

duplication.why: The category query, the income/tracking skip and the expense sign flip are pasted from set3MonthAvg, adding another copy of the month-wide selection rule.

placement.why: The action is in budget/actions.ts and registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: The 'which categories' rule now lives in yet another copy, so a change to the month-wide selection must be repeated here and can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setLastMonthSpending in budget/actions.ts filters categories in its own SQL instead of using shouldSkipBulkBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied query and loop are verbatim from set3MonthAvg, not disguised.
